name: Raise
why: Kept: walls, the first word of the role.

name: Sink
why: Kept: pits are terrain that holds an area.

name: Harden
why: Kept: solidify and armour; the tank's hide.

name: Crumble
why: Kept: break stone and guard; the tank's blow.

name: Root
why: Kept: anchor and stand firm, Braced; immovable is the role's third word.

name: Quake
why: Kept: shake an area and unbalance everything in it.

name: Dig
meaning: tear into the ground and bring stone up to throw
why: Kept, with one skill now: Slingstone. Quarry Throw moves to Buoy, whose meaning (lighten, to lift and throw) it always fitted better than Dig's (tear stone up).

name: Bury
why: Kept: cover over with earth; the tank's one-target hold.

name: Tunnel
why: Kept: under the floor; earth's way to reach somewhere else.

name: Collapse
meaning: bring the ground down and close a passage
why: Kept: bring the ground down over an area. (runes.json's as_means for Collapse says 'applies Stunned; essence cost +20%' while its effect is 'status pinned; poise x1.3'; the effect is kept as written.)

name: Weigh
meaning: add mass: grow so heavy that nothing moves you and everything near leans toward you
why: Added for the tank's missing verb: calling enemies onto you. In earth's own terms that is weight: you become the heaviest thing in the room and the room leans toward you. It revives the first pass's Weigh (design/14 section 3). A frame (holds a structure together: the heavy centre everything bonds to), drawing inward (+0.7).

name: Buoy
meaning: lighten: lift a thing out of the ground to throw it
why: Weigh's opposite, also from the first pass. Quarry Throw moves here from Dig. A link (takes in and passes on: lifts, then throws), drawing outward (-0.6, as Weigh's mirror).
